title: Issue a credential
description: Asks the principal to issue an ACDC under the schema `schema` to `issuee`, with the attributes in `attributes`. The agent answers an admitted overture by starting an IPEX exchange at grant, whose first message sets p to the exn SAID of the batch that carried the overture (spec §8.1). On completed, the results are the credential, as {said, registry}, and the IPEX grant, as {said}. The issuer decides what the credential finally says; the requester checks it before admitting the grant.

schema.description: The SAID of the credential's schema.

issuee.description: The AID the credential is issued to.

attributes.description: Attribute values the requester asks for. The issuer may refuse or change them.
